gungang.options.keyBindings.tip:
Change bindings in Minecraft's 'Gungang - Offhand Items' category.
G: attack once and return. H: use and return; hold for continuous-use items.
gungang.options.title: Gungang Settings
gungang.options.shooterHud.tip:
On: show slot 1, offhand, skin portrait and health at the bottom left.
Off: restore the vanilla hotbar and hearts. Independent of acoustic processing.
gungang.options.hint.3: Turn off and save to restore the vanilla hotbar.
gungang.options.defaults.tip: Reset drafts on ALL tabs. Save to apply.
gungang.options.invalid: Fix invalid values on all tabs before saving.
gungang.options.saveFailed: Save failed. Check the log and file permissions.
gungang.options.hint.0: Save to apply. Hover over controls for help.
gungang.options.hint.1: TaCZ keeps its own distance and silencer settings.
gungang.options.hint.2: Comma-separated entries. Leave empty to clear.
gungang.options.enabled.tip: Enable distance attenuation, wall transmission, diffraction approximation and filtering.
gungang.options.lowPass.tip: Reduce high frequencies behind obstacles. Requires OpenAL EFX.
gungang.options.diffraction.tip: Search for clear paths around an obstacle. Increases CPU work.
gungang.options.wallStrength.tip: 0–4; default 1. Higher values make walls quieter. Zero disables wall loss.
gungang.options.smoothingSeconds.tip: 0.01–1; default 0.10. Higher values smooth changes more slowly.
gungang.options.referenceDistance.tip: 0.25–16 blocks; default 2. Ordinary sounds retain near-field volume. Does not affect TaCZ.
gungang.options.rolloff.tip: 0.1–4; default 1. Higher values attenuate ordinary sounds faster. Does not affect TaCZ.
gungang.options.updatesPerTick.tip: Integer 1–128; default 12. More frequent updates for busy scenes cost more CPU.
gungang.options.maxTraceDistance.tip: Integer 16–192 blocks; default 96. Wall effects are skipped beyond this range.
gungang.options.diffractionRadius.tip: Integer 1–8 blocks; default 4. Searches 1, 2, 4 and 8 block steps up to this value.
gungang.options.excludedSounds.tip:
Example: minecraft:entity.player.hurt, tacz:*
Exact event IDs or namespace:*. tacz:* also excludes packs using TaCZ's base sound event.
gungang.options.materialOverrides.tip:
Example: minecraft:stone=18, minecraft:glass=7
Use block ID=number from 0 to 120. Higher values transmit less sound.
